en: Demon Soul?

Do ye have some new treasures that ye want to keep safe n' sound?  Ye'll be wanting to store them at The Vault with the Stonemantles.  Ye'll find The Vault just a hammer's throw northeast from the entrance to Ironforge.
Another Herbalist, hmm. I doubt your skill is as great as my own so perhaps I can train you in a few proper techniques.
FLAME! DEATH! DESTRUCTION! Cower, mortals before the wrath of Lord...NO - I MUST fight this! Alexstrasza help me, I MUST fight it!
A sacrifice will be due if I am ever called upon, mortal...

Black, grey and dark purple are the prescribed colors.  See to it that you don't stray onto the wrong side of fashion street friend.  Bowen Brisboise can help to see that you don't.  You'll find him inside Cold Hearth Manor on the other side of the bridge to the southwest of town.

You've started down an honorable path, $n. My ancestors respect your willingness, but you will not have my approval until you have followed through with my tasks.$B$BYou know what you must do if you wish to prove yourself a hunter in spirit.
Let me take a look at what you have to offer.
The Royal Apothecary Society has little patience for fools, as do I.  Perhaps the next time you and I speak of my steeds, you will be considered exalted by the Undercity.  Until then...
Here it is -- the Tanaris desert.  Funny how an inhospitable place like this looks better than a lush jungle once you've been trapped in it forever.
The Light has spoken!
This vibrant night dragon plant stands in stark contrast to the demonic taint that sunders Felwood. Rare and luscious fruit, known as Night Dragon's Breath, hang heavily from the plant.
Foolishly you have sought your own demise.

Your death will not have been in vain, Taelan. A new Order is born on this day... an Order which will dedicate itself to extinguishing the evil that plagues this world. An evil that cannot hide behind politics and pleasantries.
In Alterac Valley, battles rage and equipment is in short supply.
You need to be exalted with the trolls of the Darkspear tribe before I will teach you a riding skill, $c.

Greetings, traveler. As long as you remain within the walls of the Cenarion Hold, you will be safe from harm.$B$BBe wary when leaving the protection of the Hold as the silithid have been swarming as of late.
Excellent, $n!  You shall find Brogun Stoneshield on the Warrior's Terrace.  He can help you to get to Alterac Valley.
Nurse.
I'm your man, Ich. Give me a beacon!
It's good to be the king!  Now, let's get back to what you were talking about before...

No better place to learn First Aid than under the watchful eye of Shaina Fuller at the Cathedral of Light.  

To get there, just look for the yellow rooftops, or the towering spire of the Cathedral itself which you can see from almost anywhere in the city.
You mean, you don't know? The sword that you carry on your back - it is known as Ashbringer; named after its original owner.
How can you be so sure? If we've never dealt with the windlord directly, surely it's worth a try?
I no longer have my Zandalar Demoniac's Robe. Can you provide a replacement?
Yeah, you're a real brainiac.  Just how smart do you think you are, Slip'kik?
What do you seek, $c?

Truly, I envy you: To battle in the name of the Horde, at the forefront of conflict. Mine is a job of command.$B$BCertainly, in my youth, I lived out the dreams that make my old age bearable. I now revel in the glory of victory, the bitter taste of defeat - all through the soldiers I command.
Check out Dawnstrider Enchanters on the middle rise then.  Teg will be more than happy to help you in whatever way he can.

Ye're a fine enchanter indeed! Now it's time fer ye to move on. I want ye to talk to Gimble Thistlefuzz, upstairs. He's a bit of a character, but he'll steer ye in the right direction from here on out!
Right away, Servitor.
I hope you're well, all things considered.$B$BSit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!
All is not lost! Battle these beasts without fear. Your wounds I shall heal, bones I shall mend. Be renewed, heroes!
It'll take more than you rabble to bring me down!
Me still boss of ogres. Haw!
Hey Jangdor - can you teach me how to make Wild Leather Leggings again?
I'm gonna need some help with this $n!
If Therzok's sent you, tell him no, I won't go back to work for him, no matter how many times he asks.
Strong of body and spirit.  There can be no stronger combination!  Find your destiny with Sark Ragetotem in the Hunter's Hall.
Studying and understanding the Colossus will give us a needed advantage over the Qiraji.
The Frostwolf Graveyard was taken by the Alliance!
Go to the cleft of shadow and seek out Spellweaver Mon'ye there, near the center of the district.
